posts.title: HD2Lingo's Daily Series: A Thirty-Day Wheel That Refuses to Repeat Itself
posts.summary: One English and one Japanese lesson a day, alternating intermediate and advanced, over a 30-topic cycle that flips difficulty each round. The curriculum arithmetic, the duplicate gate that can reject a lesson, and a nightly sync that rolls itself back.
posts.keywords: Content in git, not in the database · The thirty-day wheel · A gate that is allowed to say no · Who the progress belongs to · The nightly sync, and why it rolls back · Verification · What remains · What I learned HD2Lingo started as a fixed course: 2.0.1, three units, fifteen lessons, seventy-five questions per language, for English and Japanese.
